Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting roll your own tobacco machines.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting roll your own tobacco machines; andadding a new section to chapter 70.158 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.158 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It shall be unlawful for any person to maintain a machine at aretail establishment that enables any person to process tobacco or aproduct that is made or derived from tobacco into a roll or tube. Thissection does not apply to the sale to consumers of roll your owncigarette devices that are intended for personal use off the premisesof a retail establishment.
